methods.note: The text supports HotSpot-6.0 steady-state simulation of a 10x10 mm two-tier flip-chip Mono3D IC against a TSV-based IC (PDF p.4). The extraction's own mismatch list marks the 3D tier stack, bonding layer/ILD, TSVs and heat sink on the bottom tier as essential. The experiment kind is custom_2d_steady, so a 2D reproduction would contradict the decisive vertical-coupling mechanism. The extraction also mixes Section 3.3 details (metal layers 1-8, 100x100 grids) into the Section 3.1 scenario.

code.note: No code, repository, supplementary link or pinned asset exists in the 7 PDF pages. The assets list is empty, and the HotSpot layer files and scripts used are not available.

parameters.note: Text-stated values match PDF p.4: 10 mm chip, 400 um hot spots, 750 W/cm2, backgrounds 25/30 W/cm2, 5% interconnect power with 20% to TSVs, TSV array 5mm x 200um x 33um, ~109/~77/~38/~4 C. The unit conversions are arithmetically correct. Still missing: hot spot coordinates, per-block watts, layer thicknesses and materials, and the TSV positions. The ~77 C value is ambiguous (bottom-tier hot spots vs both tiers) and approximate. The Figure 4 values were not visually verified.

config.note: The heat sink, spreader, convection resistance, ambient temperature, layer stack and HotSpot config/grid settings for the Section 3.1 run are not published. The 100x100 grid and metal layers 1-8 come from Section 3.3 (p.6) and are not shown to apply to Figure 4.

data.note: There are no same-scenario floorplan blocks or per-block power rows (floorplan and power_w are empty). Upper-tier hot spot positions are not numeric, and Figure 3/4 images are not supplied. Generated 2D shelf coordinates and constant power rows would be illustrative assumptions, not published placement or transient traces.

findings.reason: The decisive observables (inter-tier coupling, ~38 C vs ~4 C tier difference, TSV/bonding-layer effects) are 3D phenomena. A 2D reproduction would contradict the paper's physics, and the extraction itself flags this as essential.
The 100x100 grid figure appears only in the Section 3.3 runtime remark. Attributing it to the Section 3.1 Figure 4 scenario with a p.4 locator is unsupported.
findings.locator: PDF p.6 Section 3.3 vs extraction original_setup.solver (cites p.4)

findings.reason: Metal layers 1-8 and linear interconnect power distribution belong to Section 3.3. Section 3.1 says only that all metal layers are modeled, so mixing the two is a scenario mismatch.
findings.locator: PDF p.4 Section 3.1 vs p.6 Section 3.3

findings.reason: The text says hot spots on the upper tier lead to similar hot spots on the bottom tier reaching ~77 C, which is ambiguous about which tier and which aggregation. Figure 4c/4d was not visually verified and the value is approximate, so the observable is not decisively verified.
findings.locator: PDF p.4 Section 3.1; Figure 4 on p.5 (image not supplied)

findings.reason: Upper-tier hot spot coordinates were not digitized from Figure 3, and the floorplan list and power_w are empty. No block has same-scenario power, so floorplan completeness is not satisfied.
The source_value and unit fields are null although the dimensions are published in the text (5 mm x 200 um x 33 um). The record is internally inconsistent, and the TSV positions are unknown.
The heat sink, spreader, convection and ambient settings are not specified in the paper. Any cooling stack used would be an assumption, so temperatures cannot be compared with the paper's.
findings.locator: PDF p.4 Section 3.1 and Figure 2 on p.4

findings.reason: No pinned assets or figure images were supplied. Figures 3, 4 and 5-8 contain only garbled pdftotext axis labels, so no decisive figure was visually verified.
